decision.explanation: Multiple distinct churches share this name with conflicting dates: the Alcamo church has contradictory records of 1660 and 1750 (where 1660 is supported by two consistent sources against one outlier), the Goa church was built in 1544–1547, and the Asmara church was built in 1923.
